rules.name: no_external_screen
rules.description: All selected positions from the original spot rotation replay, including windows before futures metrics are available.

rules.name: metrics_matched_base
rules.description: Only selected positions with a point-in-time futures metrics row available within the max-age guard.

rules.name: skip_oi_expansion_1h_gt_1p5
rules.description: Skip entries when same-symbol open-interest notional expanded more than 1.5% over the previous hour.

rules.name: skip_europe_session
rules.description: Skip Europe-session entries as a coarse proxy for the CT-180 session fragility finding.

rules.name: skip_oi_expansion_or_europe
rules.description: Skip entries if either OI expansion is high or the entry is in Europe session.

rules.name: skip_top_crowding_spread_gt_0p25
rules.description: Skip entries when top-trader long/short crowding is more than 0.25 above the global ratio.

rules.name: skip_oi_expansion_or_top_crowding
rules.description: Skip entries if OI expansion is high or top-trader crowding is materially above the global ratio.
